create_NaturalLanguageQueries_dataset: create a NaturalLanguageQueries dataset instance with text and video params for Ego4D NLQ data loading
load_metadata_NaturalLanguageQueries: load Ego4D NLQ metadata from JSON annotation files into a pandas DataFrame for train val or test splits
sample_visual_features: sample and downsample visual features from video clips to a fixed max number of clips using mean pooling
extract_video_text_features: extract paired video frames and tokenized text features from a dataset item by index for model input
get_video_path: get the full video file path and relative path from a sample row in the metadata DataFrame
